parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT activity_id, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type IN ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50') AND a.standard_value < 50 ORDER BY activity_id ASC LIMIT 200
